items.basis: Google confirmed Jul 21 that flagship 3.5 Pro is still in partner testing (a fourth missed target) and Gemini 4 pre-training has begun; it shipped cheaper 3.6 Flash tiers instead. Polymarket 'next Gemini Pro by Aug 7' ~73%.
Polymarket 'GPT-6 released by' 89% for Dec 31 (75% Sep 30, 36% Aug 31); OpenAI's most recent flagship work is the GPT-5.6 suite.
Moonshot promised full open weights for its 2.8T-param K3 (Modified MIT) by Jul 27, amid US 'industrial distillation' accusations; model is already live via API and independently scored AA 57.
Manifold 'Grok 5 before Sep 2026' ~16%; V9 foundation (now under SpaceXAI) reportedly still training on Colossus 2 after the Jul 8 Grok 4.5 launch.
Google confirmed Jul 21 that Gemini 4 pre-training has begun; no dated market yet.
